title: Kinematic vs. mechanical? A patient-centered investigation into the optimal alignment for total knee arthroplasty
summary: Retrospektive Analyse der operativen Ausrichtung bei primären Knietotalendoprothesen um herauszufinden, von welcher Ausrichtung die Patienten am meisten profitieren.

interventions.name:
Patients with primary total knee arthroplasty
Retrospectiv Data analysis of patient characteristics, PROMS (WOMAC Score) and pre vs postoperative X-Rays.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Primary total knee arthroplasty
Exclusion criteria:
Unter 18 years of age, Revision Knee surgery
